acceptance: TPC-DS SF0.01 loads through the bulk path with per-column checksum parity against the VALUES loader on Trino and Presto.
varbinary text either loads natively with hex parity or the fallback is documented with its reason.
description:
PR #4082: delimited-text tables with varbinary columns, quoted CSV, custom Presto null markers and non-UTF-8 files fall back to the VALUES loader. The new all-varchar external table plus CAST projection was verified live only on TPC-H SF0.01 and a small smoke table; decimals with spaces, dates, timestamps and very wide tables (TPC-DS, 715-column OBT) were not. Related existing item: perf-trino-presto-hive-target-sf1-20261110.

Change. Run TPC-DS and one wide table through the bulk path on Trino and Presto in CI or mocker, compare value checksums with the VALUES loader, and decide whether a hex-decoding projection (from_hex) can cover varbinary text.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing; no live cloud without owner approval quoted in context; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
